items.title: Which Tech Stocks Are Getting Hit Hardest Today
items.summary: The technology sector was the S&P 500's worst performer today, down 1.7%. Here are some of the tech names getting hit hardest:    Corning, down 14% (worst performer in the S&P 500)   Teradyne, down 13%   Coherent, down 13%.

items.title: Skyworks Is Trading 18% Above Its Own Price Target. Overbought or Something Else?
items.summary: Skyworks just blew past every analyst price target while gutting its dividend, piling on debt, and watching its CFO sell shares into the surge. Something is driving this rally that the sell side has not priced in yet, and figuring out whether it is genius or gravity takes some digging.

items.title: Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of wireless chips maker Skyworks Solutions (NASDAQ: SWKS) jumped 9.1% in the morning session after Chief Executive Officer Phil Brace announced at an investor conference that the company's $22 billion merger with Qorvo has reached its final stages with two regulatory jurisdictions remaining.

items.title: SWKS Stock Just Hit a New 52-Week High. What Comes Next.
items.summary: Skyworks stock rallies as Qorvo deal enters final stages. But options data suggests SWKS shares will reverse recent gains in the days ahead.

items.title: Why This Apple Supplier Is on Pace for Its Best 5-Day Stretch in 17 Years
items.summary: Skyworks Solutions stock surges Friday and builds on a strong move from the previous session as CEO Philip Brace set the timeline for the completion of a key merger.

items.title: Apple Advances 3% as First Foldable iPhone Arrives at Its Highest Price Ever; Skyworks Rallies 9%, Alphabet Ticks Up
items.summary: Apple just repriced the entire iPhone lineup from the top down, and the supplier shockwaves are already hitting the tape in ways that go beyond the usual launch-day noise.

items.title: Skyworks Rises 7%, Qorvo Gains 5% as CEO Says $22B Merger Is in Final Stages; Qualcomm Ticks Up
items.summary: Skyworks CEO Phil Brace just went on the record at an investor conference with a statement that sent both SWKS and QRVO surging, and it shifts the entire risk calculus on one of the biggest chip deals of the decade.

items.title: Strength Seen in Skyworks (SWKS): Can Its 9.8% Jump Turn into More Strength?
items.summary: Skyworks (SWKS) witnessed a jump in share price last session on above-average trading volume. The latest trend in earnings estimate revisions for the stock doesn't suggest further strength down the road.
